observations.body: Behold, then I would wander far off.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The speaker imagines wandering far off and lodging in the wilderness.
observations.label: A desired refuge

observations.body: The wilderness is imagined as distance from violence rather than the source of danger.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Psalms 55:5–9 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Escape is desired, but the prayer has not yet changed the speaker’s situation.
payload.title: A wish to lodge far away
